newsitem.title: USA: Boston Chicken named in lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Boston Chicken named in lawsuit.

text.p: Boston Chicken Inc was named as a defendant in a purported class action lawsuit filed in U.S. District Court for the District of Colorado, lawyers for the plaintiffs said Tuesday.

The suit alleges securities law violations and seeks to recover losses suffered by investors who bought Boston Chicken securities, according to a statement by the law firms Hagens & Berman, Kaufman Malchman Kirby & Squire and Dyer Donnelly.
Boston Chicken Chief Executive Scott Beck and Chief Financial Officer Mark Stephens were also named as defendants.
Company officials were not available for comment.
Karl Barth of Hagens & Berman said the complaint alleges Boston Chicken failed to consolidate the results of individual restaurants, thus artificially inflating earnings.
"The exact amount of damages has not been calculated, but it is a material amount," he said in a telephone interview.
The class of plaintiffs comprises those who bought Boston Chicken securities between August 13, 1996, and May 30, 1997.
